content: आवाप {%a.%} [आवप्-घञ्] Throwing, scattering; (as in अक्षावाप <ab>q. v.</ab>). .{@-पः@} .²1 Sowing seed. .²2 Scattering, throwing in general; casting, directing. .²3 Mixing, inserting. .²4 Especially, throwing additional ingredients into a compound in course of preparation. .²5 A basin for water round the root of a tree (आलवाल). .²6 A vessel, jar for corn. .²7 Setting out or arranging vessels. .²8 Hostile purpose, intention of fighting (with another); foreign affairs; ‘तन्त्रः स्वराङ्कचिन्तायामावापः परचिन्तने’ इति वैजयन्ती; तन्त्रावापविद् <ls>Śi. 2. 88</ls>. .²9 A principal sacrifice or oblation to fire. .²10 A kind of drink. .²11 A bracelet (आवापक). .²12 Uneven ground. .²13 Decentralisation, a matter which serves several persons or things only if repeated with each one of them (<ab>opp.</ab> तन्त्र <ab>q. v.</ab>) यस्तु आवृत्त्या उपकरोति स आवापः . यथा तेषामेव ब्राह्मणानामनुलेपनम् . <ls>ŚB. on MS. 11. 1. 1</ls>.
